tools.name: vidyard_list_accounts
tools.description: List the Vidyard accounts this API token can reach, with the token's roles and permissions. Good first call to check the connection. The token value itself is never returned. Dashboard API: GET /accounts.

tools.name: vidyard_list_organizations
tools.description: List the organizations (folders) this token can access. Organization ids are needed by some other tools. Dashboard API: GET /organizations.

tools.name: vidyard_get_organization
tools.description: Get one organization (folder) by id. Dashboard API: GET /organizations/{id}.

tools.name: vidyard_list_roles
tools.description: List the roles in the account. Shows what the token's role may do. Dashboard API: GET /roles.

tools.name: vidyard_list_users
tools.description: List users in the account, optionally filtered by team. Dashboard API: GET /users.

tools.name: vidyard_list_hubs
tools.description: List Vidyard hubs (branded video pages) in the account. Dashboard API: GET /hubs.

tools.name: vidyard_list_players
tools.description: List players (the shareable video pages that wrap a video) in the account. Use vidyard_search_players to filter by name or tag. Dashboard API: GET /players.

tools.name: vidyard_search_players
tools.description: Search players by name, UUID, description, tags or internal notes. All filters combine with AND. Results are paginated. Dashboard API: GET /players/search.

tools.name: vidyard_get_player
tools.description: Get one player by id: name, description, status, embed and sharing settings. Dashboard API: GET /players/{id}.

tools.name: vidyard_get_player_by_uuid
tools.description: Get one player by its UUID. Dashboard API: GET /players/uuid={uuid}.

tools.name: vidyard_get_player_tags
tools.description: List the tags attached to one player. Dashboard API: GET /players/{player_id}/tags.

tools.name: vidyard_list_videos
tools.description: List videos in the account. A player wraps a video; use vidyard_list_players for the shareable page. Dashboard API: GET /videos.

tools.name: vidyard_get_video
tools.description: Get one video by id: name, description, status and length. Dashboard API: GET /videos/{id}.

tools.name: vidyard_get_video_status
tools.description: Get the current length of a video. Use it for a video still in progress. Dashboard API: GET /videos/{id}/status.

tools.name: vidyard_get_video_encoding_status
tools.description: Get the encoding status of a video after upload (is it ready to play). Dashboard API: GET /videos/{id}/encoding_status.

tools.name: vidyard_list_tags
tools.description: List tags, optionally filtered by name or by the id of the item they tag. Dashboard API: GET /tags.

tools.name: vidyard_list_tag_names
tools.description: List distinct tag names that contain a search string. Dashboard API: GET /tags/names.

tools.name: vidyard_search_events
tools.description: Search interactive events (CTAs, overlays, popups) that belong to the organization. Dashboard API: GET /events/search.

tools.name: vidyard_update_player
tools.description: Change a player's name or description. Other fields are left as they are. Use the player id from vidyard_search_players. Dashboard API: PATCH /players/{id}.

tools.name: vidyard_create_tag
tools.description: Create a new tag and attach it to one player or uploader widget. New tags must use Player or UploaderWidget (Vidyard no longer accepts Video for new tags). Dashboard API: POST /tags.
